description: This source file defines the UpdateContentsHandler class, which manages content item lifecycle events such as initialization, creation, updating, versioning, publishing, and unpublishing within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: UpdateContentsHandler
classes.description: Handles content item lifecycle events to set ownership, timestamps, and author information based on HTTP context and clock.

methods.name: InitializingAsync
methods.description: Sets the owner and author of the content item during initialization if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: CreatingAsync
methods.description: Sets creation and modification timestamps; assigns owner and author if not already set during content creation.

methods.name: UpdatingAsync
methods.description: Updates the modification timestamp and author during content updates if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: VersioningAsync
methods.description: Copies ownership and timestamps to a new version of the content item.

methods.name: PublishingAsync
methods.description: Sets creation and published timestamps when content is published.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync
methods.description: Clears the published timestamp when content is unpublished.
